home.recentHelp: Each row keeps its own signaling server. Pick the role for this device.

rolePicker.subtitle: Privacy baby monitor — choose this device's role
rolePicker.instructionRest: set up the baby phone, then connect the parent phone using the code from the baby screen.
rolePicker.babyHint: Place near your child; listens and streams audio.
rolePicker.parentHint: Stay with you; alerts and listen controls.

connectionStatus.hintParentGiveUp: Check the baby phone is on and on the same Wi-Fi (or both have mobile data).
connectionStatus.hintBabyGiveUp: Open GuardedSleep on the parent device.

capabilities.secureContextBabyMicHint: Open this site over HTTPS (or localhost) to use the baby unit microphone and WebRTC. Pairing and settings still work on this connection.
capabilities.webVersusNativeHint: You are in the web app. For background monitoring, system alarms, and kiosk options, use the GuardedSleep Android build. The browser version works for pairing and live sessions over HTTPS.

signaling.useDefaultTitle: Clear saved URL and use build-time default
signaling.validationProtocol: Only ws:// or wss:// is allowed

settings.title: Settings
settings.returnBabyHelp: After you finish here, go back to monitoring on this device.
settings.generalIntro: Defaults that apply when you start the app without a full invitation link. Pairing QR codes still carry their own connection details.
settings.signalingHelp: Advanced: default WebSocket for discovery. Invites from QR always use the server embedded in the invite.
settings.childIntro1: These values apply on this device when it runs as the baby unit. They are stored locally and picked up when monitoring starts.
settings.childIntro2: From a connected parent, use "Open settings on baby device" to jump this phone here (same trust as listen controls).
settings.parentIntro: Listen, snooze, link quality, and notifications are on the Parent unit screen during a session.

babySound.sensitivityLabel: Sensitivity — how loud counts as noise ({{value}})
babySound.holdTitle: How long noise must stay loud
babySound.holdHelp: Ignores brief sounds. Longer waits mean fewer alerts, but slower reaction.

baby.title: Baby unit
baby.parentConnectedTitle: WebRTC session is up with the parent unit.
baby.waitingParentTitle: Room and server in the URL only configure this device—they do not prove the parent has joined yet.
baby.blurbConnected: Session is live with the parent phone. Noise detection still uses the microphone on this device.
baby.blurbConnecting: Contacting the server and opening the microphone so the parent unit can find this device. The parent must open their session separately (for example after scanning the QR on their phone).
baby.blurbFailed: Could not complete setup or the link dropped. Retries run in the background; you can also tap "Try now" below.
baby.blurbIdle: Room + server in the link only configure this device. They do not mean the parent has already joined. This page will connect automatically so the parent can pair when they are ready.
baby.failedHint: This is separate from "waiting for parent"—here the app could not keep a session open.
baby.retriesStopped: Automatic retries stopped. Use the button below.
baby.micLevelHelp: The bar moves once the mic is open and this device is in a live or connecting session.
baby.footer: We start the session automatically so the parent can find this device as soon as they join the same room—having room and signal in the URL does not by itself mean the parent is online yet. Android: foreground notification + mDNS _guardedsleep._tcp.
baby.batteryAlertWeb: Battery settings are opened by the Android system. Use the GuardedSleep Android app on a phone or tablet, then tap this button again.

parent.snoozeDialogHelp: Alerts stay muted for the chosen time. Listening is unchanged.
parent.title: Parent unit
parent.pillSessionUpTitle: Signaling and WebRTC are up; the baby may only send audio during alerts or when you tap Listen.
parent.pillAudioReadyTitle: A media track from the baby unit is available to play.
parent.blurbConnected: You are paired with the baby unit for this room. Noise alerts and the live listen button use the stream from the child device.
parent.blurbConnecting: Joining the signaling server for this room and waiting for the baby unit. Having room and signal in the URL only tells this phone where to register—it does not guarantee the baby app is already online.
parent.blurbFailed: Could not stay connected to the baby unit. Check that both phones are on the same Wi-Fi or both have mobile data, and that the baby phone is on and not restricted.
parent.blurbIdle: This page will open a session automatically. The baby device must also run GuardedSleep with the same room and server before status can become connected.
parent.failedBannerTitle: Could not reach the baby unit
parent.failedBannerHint: This is different from simply waiting—the session ended or never came up.
parent.babyCardHelp: Open app settings on the phone or tablet that is running as the baby unit. The child device must stay unlocked or awake enough to switch screens.
parent.footer: A session starts automatically so you can pair as soon as the baby device is in the same room. Use Restart session if the status stays stuck or after changing networks.
parent.batteryAlertWeb: Battery settings are opened by the Android system. Use the GuardedSleep Android app on a phone or tablet, then tap this button again.

pair.loopbackBody: A second device on Wi-Fi cannot reach it—there, 127.0.0.1 always means the device itself. In Settings → General, set the WebSocket URL to this computer's LAN IP (for example wss://192.168.…:8443/…), then generate the QR again.
pair.qrScanHint: Scan with the other phone—contains room code, server, and pairing secret. Only share with people you trust.

errors.roomFormat: Room code: 4–64 characters; letters, numbers, underscore, and hyphen only.
errors.roleMissing: Device role missing — open the home page or use the invite link.
errors.inviteIncomplete: Invite incomplete — you need a room code and a WebSocket address (ws:// or wss://).
errors.unknownJoinInput: Unknown input. Use the full link or QR text — or only the room code if this device and the baby device use the same signaling server (Settings).

invite.openedPrompt: Invite link opened. Which device is this one here?
invite.noRoleSuffix: or open the invite QR link.

baby.intro1: This device stays with the child. A pairing QR code appears below.
baby.intro2: On your second phone (with you): open GuardedSleep and choose With me (parent). Then scan the QR code here — or paste the same link or text if you already have it.

parent.step1: On the phone that stays with the child: open GuardedSleep and choose At the child (baby monitor).
parent.step2: Wait until that device shows a large QR code.
parent.step3: On this phone (with you): scan the QR code or paste the invite into the Invite or room code field.
parent.joinPlaceholder: Link, QR text (JSON), or room code only
parent.joinHint: QR / Link contains room and server — safest. Room code only works if baby and parent devices use the same signaling server (build default or in Settings).
parent.inviteAnotherBody: Same room code and pairing secret as on the baby device so a second parent phone can join. If you already scanned the baby code, the secret is carried over here.

scanner.cameraDenied: Camera access denied. Allow it in the browser settings or use Snap QR photo / gallery.
scanner.cameraNotFound: No suitable camera found. Use Snap QR photo, gallery, or the text field.
scanner.cameraNotSupported: Live camera not supported here. Use HTTPS (or localhost) or Snap QR photo / gallery.
scanner.cameraUnavailable: Live camera unavailable. Use Snap QR photo (system camera), gallery, or the field above.
scanner.liveCameraUnsupported: Live camera is not supported for this page. Try Snap QR photo, gallery, or HTTPS (e.g. port 8443).
scanner.secureContextTip: Tip: Without HTTPS some phones block the built-in live camera — then use Snap QR photo (system camera) or https://…
scanner.noQrInImage: No QR code found in this image.
scanner.qrInvalidInvite: QR read, but not a valid GuardedSleep invite.
scanner.qrUnreadable: Could not read QR from the image. Try a sharper photo or a different mode.
scanner.previewNotReady: Camera preview not ready. Please try again.
scanner.snapPhotoTitle: Opens the system camera to take a photo — often works without HTTPS.
scanner.snapPhotoHelp: Snap QR photo opens the normal camera app (as before) — often reliable with http:// on the home network. If Live scan fails: try HTTPS or use this button.
